requirements.quote: Members, officers, staff, and employees of the Syracuse Regional Airport Authority may respond to this RFP only in accordance with the Authority’s Code of Ethics.
requirements.text: Respondents must comply with the Authority's Code of Ethics.

requirements.quote: The selected Contractor shall be required to purchase at its own cost and expense and maintain at all times for the duration of the contract with the Authority, insurance coverage as specified below.
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain specified insurance coverage during the contract.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall obtain and for the duration of the contract, maintain a Commercial General Liability insurance policy including contractual liability coverage, with minimum limits of: • Bodily Injury and Property Damage Limit $1,000,000 each occurrence • Products/Completed Operations Limit $2,000,000 aggregate • Personal Injury & Advertising Injury Limit $4,000,000 each person/organization • General Aggregate $4,000,000 applicable on a per project basis
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain Commercial General Liability insurance with specified limits.

requirements.quote: The General Liability policy shall name the Authority and the City of Syracuse and their respective members, officers, staff, and employees as additional insureds for both ongoing and completed operations.
requirements.text: General Liability policy must name specified entities as additional insureds.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall obtain and maintain workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance policy or policies covering its obligations in accordance with the provisions of New York Workers' Compensation Law.
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance.

requirements.quote: The Contractor shall obtain and maintain a commercial umbrella/excess insurance policy with annual aggregate coverage of at least one million Dollars ($1,000,000) for the
requirements.text: Contractor must maintain commercial umbrella/excess insurance with specified coverage.

requirements.quote: The schedule of underlying insurance, additional insured follow form or its equivalent and endorsements must be provided to the Authority.
requirements.text: Contractor must provide insurance schedule and endorsements to the Authority.

requirements.quote: After a proposer(s) is recommended by the Authority’s review committee, and if necessary approved by the Authority’s Board, an agreement incorporating the agreed upon compensation and scope of services and other relevant terms will be drafted by the Authority’s counsel and submitted to the successful proposer.
requirements.text: Authority will draft and submit agreement to successful proposer.

requirements.quote: Please provide a lump sum (LS) price that covers the manufacturing, furnishing, delivering, and testing of the new switchgear.
requirements.text: Bidder must provide lump sum price for switchgear manufacturing, furnishing, delivering, and testing.

requirements.quote: Please also include in your cost proposal: 1. Special Tools necessary for installation, testing and maintenance.
requirements.text: Cost proposal must include special tools for installation, testing, and maintenance.

requirements.quote: 2. Necessary drawings, instructions and test reports in the English language.
requirements.text: Cost proposal must include English drawings, instructions, and test reports.

requirements.quote: 3. In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files.
requirements.text: Final drawings must be submitted in AutoCAD format.
Cost proposal must include maintenance equipment and spare parts.
Cost proposal must include start-up and training.

requirements.quote: By submission of this proposal, each Respondent and each person signing on behalf of any Respondent certifies, and in the case of a joint proposal each party thereto certifies as to its own organization, under penalty of perjury, that to the best of knowledge and belief:
requirements.text: Respondent must certify proposal compliance under penalty of perjury.

requirements.quote: The prices in this proposal have been arrived at independently without collusion, consultation, communication, or agreement, for the purpose of restricting competition, as to any matter relating to such prices with any other Respondent, or with any competitor;
requirements.text: Prices must be determined independently without collusion.

requirements.quote: No attempt has been made or will be made by the Respondent to induce any other person, partnership or corporation to submit or not to submit a proposal for purpose of restricting competition.
requirements.text: Respondent must not induce others to restrict competition.
